title: How a Website Loads in Under a Second
author: Arjun Nair
summary: From typing a URL to seeing a page: DNS, servers, HTML, CSS and JavaScript explained step by step.
image_alt: Diagram showing a browser requesting a web page from a server
body: When you enter a URL, the browser finds the server through DNS and requests the page.
The server returns HTML. The browser then loads CSS for styling and JavaScript for behavior.
Small images and clean markup help pages load faster. See {{writing-accessible-content}} for related best practices.
